strength: The free browser plan includes 10 credits for trimming, captions, and resizing video.
weakness: Free exports are watermarked, limited to 4 minutes at 720p, with 5 GB of storage, and a Pro monthly price was not clearly listed.
smokeTestNotes: Official site and pricing page were fetched. No account was created.
name: Kapwing
shortDescription: Browser editor for trimming, captions, and resizing video into social clips.
longDescription: Kapwing is an online video editor. Its pricing page lists a Free plan with 10 credits, a watermark, exports up to 4 minutes, 720p, and 5 GB of storage. A dollar amount for the lowest paid plan was not clearly tied to the Pro plan in the text we extracted, so the starting price stays unconfirmed. We did not create an account.
freeTierNotes: 10 credits. Watermark. Exports up to 4 minutes at 720p. 5 GB storage.
bestFor: Adding captions or resizing a video in the browser
Turning a longer video into a social clip
notIdealFor: Connecting a Twitch channel and clipping the VOD automatically
